eod.conclusion: Indian equities closed lower after failing to maintain early gains, with the Nifty and Sensex both declining. The banking sector showed relative resilience with a smaller drop. Market sentiment appeared cautious despite earlier sessions' positive momentum, as investors weighed corporate earnings against broader economic indicators. Select stocks outperformed on strong results, while auto and currency markets faced pressure.
